description.short_caption: Multiple hypopigmented scaly patches on the face, neck, and chest.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows multiple hypopigmented, scaly patches distributed across the face, neck, and chest. The lesions vary in size and shape, with irregular borders and a fine scale. The distribution appears symmetric, and the lesions are more prominent on the chest. The skin texture suggests a superficial fungal or inflammatory process.
visible_findings: distribution on face, neck, and chest
